python3 -c "
import json, subprocess, sys

# Write a verdict for session ABC
verdict = {'session_id': 'session-abc', 'flags': ['27 tool calls'], 'assessment': 'degraded'}
with open('analyzer/last_verdict.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(verdict, f)

# Case 1: Same session -> should inject
r1 = subprocess.run(
    ['python3', 'hooks/on_prompt_check.py'],
    input=json.dumps({'session_id': 'session-abc', 'prompt': 'hello'}),
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
assert '27 tool calls' in r1.stdout, 'Expected injection for matching session'
print('on_prompt_check SAME session: PASS (injected warning)')

# Case 2: Different session -> should NOT inject
r2 = subprocess.run(
    ['python3', 'hooks/on_prompt_check.py'],
    input=json.dumps({'session_id': 'session-xyz-new', 'prompt': 'hello'}),
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
assert r2.stdout == '', f'Expected no injection for different session, got: {repr(r2.stdout)}'
print('on_prompt_check DIFFERENT session: PASS (no injection)')

# Case 3: No session_id -> should NOT inject
r3 = subprocess.run(
    ['python3', 'hooks/on_prompt_check.py'],
    input=json.dumps({'prompt': 'hello'}),
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
assert r3.stdout == '', f'Expected no injection when no session_id, got: {repr(r3.stdout)}'
print('on_prompt_check NO session_id: PASS (no injection)')
print('All on_prompt_check tests PASSED')
"
